basis: The dashboard shows the Product B bar is the shortest on the chart, with its top positioned just above the 5,000 unit grid line. This visual evidence places the unit count in the 5,000 to 6,000 range. Comparing this to the policy table, the 'Demand follow-up queue activation level' applies to units sold between 3,000 and 5,200. Because the visual evidence indicates Product B sold more than 5,200 units (just above the 5,000 mark), it does not qualify for the low-demand follow-up route. It also does not meet the criteria for urgent escalation (< 3,000), expanded replenishment (>= 20,000), or growth allocation (>= 35,000). The manual verification band (< 1,500 from a threshold) is not clearly triggered because the specific threshold is undefined and the value is not within 1,500 of the 5,200 or 20,000 boundaries. Therefore, the product remains on its standard plan.
option_label: Keep Product B on regular merchandising plan
